integrity: The standard equation and stable-limit-cycle background were checked in a peer-reviewed open reference. A complete open mathematical article on deterministic van der Pol time averages was inspected throughout its model and bounding framework, including targeted searches for moment, variance, conditional, virial, and fourth-moment formulations. Published semantic searches and the available prior ledger claims were compared against conditional, moment-hierarchy, virial, and fourth-moment aliases. The all-test-function identity, kinetic-energy measure reconstruction, moment hierarchy, energy balance, and strict equality cases were independently reconstructed; exact polynomial algebra was replayed from the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures of the deterministic autonomous oscillator.
The reconstruction determines the position projection of \(v^2d\pi\), not the full joint invariant measure.
The universal bound \(\mathbb E[x^2]<3\) is not a sharp formula for limit-cycle amplitude or period.
The 1920 historical source is year-resolved in the checked bibliographic record and is not used to invent a day-level first-public date.
An equivalent weak-generator identity could remain in unindexed historical oscillator literature.
title: Stationary kinetic-energy reconstruction and an exact fourth-moment law for the van der Pol oscillator
